article_content: Samoa Air has introduced innovative seating solutions to better accommodate larger passengers, featuring expanded seating configurations and accessibility improvements. The airline's CEO, Chris Langton, explained that the new two-seat couch-style arrangement provides an additional 14 inches of legroom by removing forward seats, while boarding ramps now replace traditional stairs to assist heavier travelers. This initiative complements Samoa Air's unique weight-based pricing system, which calculates fares according to total body plus luggage weight - a model adopted due to Samoa's reported high prevalence of obesity. With 80% of residents reportedly overweight since 2007, the airline accommodates customers weighing up to 210 kilograms through these measures. While criticized for potentially encouraging poor health habits, the airline frames its policies as operational necessities rather than health judgments. A linked fitness program rewards weight loss with discounted flights, aiming to balance commercial needs with passenger welfare.

Dette initiativet støtter Samoa Airs unike vektbaserte prismodell, der prisen beregnes etter kombinert kropp- og bagasjevekt - et system innført pga. Samoas høy andel overvægtige innbyggere (80% siden 2007). Selskapet tilrettelegger nå kunder opp til 210 kg. Selv om det kritiseres for mulig utsporing av dårlige helsevaner, definerer selskapet sine tiltak som nødvendige operasjoner, ikke helseforklaringer. Et koblet treningssystem belønner vekttap med flyrabatter, med mål om å balansere økonomi og passasjervelvære.

article_content: Elon Musk's artificial intelligence division xAI has launched its inaugural product, Grōk—a conversational chatbot slated for rollout to X Premium+ users upon completing early testing phases. Announced via Musk's social media platform, Grōk differentiates itself through real-time interaction with X content and a witty communication style marked by sarcasm. The startup's 12-person engineering team, composed entirely of men, aims to 'decipher the universe's fundamental truths,' per its website, positioning itself as both competitor to OpenAI and successor to Musk's proposed TruthGPT initiative. Initial trials show Grōk's playful side, such as responding to a cocaine-making inquiry with mock enthusiasm before adding cautionary disclaimers. This contrasts with ChatGPT's polite refusal and Bard's dismissive response. The name originates from sci-fi author Robert A. Heinlein's concept of intuitive understanding, though its current implementation prioritizes digital humor over philosophical depth.

article_content: Pakistani officials have identified Friday's Lahore attacks targeting Ahmadi places of worship as the work of Taliban-linked militants from Waziristan. Punjab Police Spokesman Akram Naeem stated the attackers originated from the Taliban stronghold region. Interior Minister Rehman Malik acknowledged intelligence received earlier this month about potential Lahore attacks but admitted insufficient countermeasures were taken. The coordinated assaults involved explosives and automatic weapons, killing 98 people - 75 at the Model Town complex where one perpetrator was apprehended. The Human Rights Commission of Pakistan condemned the violence, noting they had warned Punjab authorities about threats to Ahmadis since 2023. The Ahmadiyya Community, founded in 1889 and claiming 3-4 million followers in Pakistan, faces systemic discrimination including legal prohibitions against: identifying their prayer spaces as mosques, performing Islamic calls to prayer, distributing religious materials, and participating in Hajj pilgrimages. The US Commission on International Religious Freedom identifies Ahmadis as Pakistan's most severely restricted religious minority, facing both state-mandated restrictions and extremist violence.

article_content: WPC Kelly Jones, 33, has filed a health and safety lawsuit against the owner of a petrol station in Thetford, Norfolk, after tripping on a 6-inch kerb during an investigation. The officer responded to a midnight 999 call reporting a suspected burglary at Nuns’ Bridges Service Station but later claimed the premises’ owner failed to mitigate risks. Seeking compensation, her legal team argues the call exposed her to ‘unnecessary injury risk’, sparking national debate over liability in emergencies. MPs, including Home Affairs Committee Chair Keith Vaz, demand clearer guidelines to prevent public hesitation in contacting emergency services. Owner Steve Jones dismissed the claim as absurd, stating: ‘Police officers accept inherent risks when serving the public – why should homeowners now fear lawsuits?’ Documents allege insufficient lighting and lack of warnings about the kerb, despite Jones continuing the search post-fall. Norfolk Constabulary confirmed no prior knowledge of the case, managed independently by the Police Federation. Critics warn the outcome could redefine duty-of-care expectations in public safety scenarios.

article_content: CHICAGO — Legendary producer Quincy Jones, singer Jennifer Hudson, and rapper Chance the Rapper (Chancelor Bennett) have become co-owners of Chicago’s historic Ramova Theatre on the South Side. The ownership group announced its formation Wednesday, per the Chicago Sun-Times. The landmark, shuttered since 1985, was acquired by developer Tyler Nevius—who now co-owns it—in 2017 for $1, along with an adjacent lot. All three artists are Chicago natives. 'My mother taught us to prioritize our community,' Hudson shared, calling the theater’s restoration 'a dream come true.' Bennett emphasized Chicago’s enduring influence: 'This venture lets me give back while spotlighting the city’s unmatched creativity.' Originally a 1929 cinema, the Ramova avoided demolition and gained historic designation in 2021. Plans include a 1,500-seat live venue, beer garden, and grill. No reopening date is set. Partner Other Half Brewing will contribute to the project. Jones envisions the theater as a beacon for Chicago’s arts scene: 'This will inspire future generations and celebrate our city’s soul.'

Teatret, som har vært stengt siden 1985, ble kjøpt av utvikler Tyler Nevius – nå også med-eier – i 2017 for $1, sammen med et tilhørende område. Alle tre artistene er født i Chicago. «Min mor lærte oss å ta vare på hjemmet først», sa Hudson, som kaller gjenopprettelsen av teatret «en drøm som blir virkelighet». Bennett understrekte Chicagos evige betydning: «Dette prosjektet lar meg gi tilbake samtidig som jeg lyser opp for byens uerstattelige kreativitet.» Bygget, et kino fra 1929, unngikk nedbygging og fikk historisk status i 2021. Planene inkluderer et 1.500-plassig live-scene, ølbunnen og grillsted. Åpningstidspunkt er ikke bekendtgjort. Samarbeidspartneren Other Half Brewing deltar i prosjektet. Jones ser fram til at teatret blir et symbol for Chicagos kunstneriske scene: «Dette vil inspirere fremtidige generasjoner og feire vår bys sjel.»
